home_question: I ni cɛ, aw bisimila nyɛ kɔrɔ kan. I bolo digi k'a to a kan walisa ne ka i ɲɛfɔ a nafa ye.
home_desc_document: Sɛbɛn. Digili kɛ ka sɛbɛn foto ta.
home_desc_contacts: Mɔgɔw. Digili kɛ ka somɔgɔw wele.
home_desc_health: Kɛnɛya. Digili kɛ i ka furaw kama.
home_desc_map: Karti. Digili kɛ ka dɛmɛ yɔrɔw ɲini.
contacts_tts_intro: I bɛ mɔgɔw nyɛ kan. Yan, i bɛ se ka somɔgɔw wele wala ka foto ci u ma. Digili kɛ weleli yɔrɔ kan.
contacts_no_permission: I ma sɔn ka mɔgɔw yira.
contacts_desc_open_settings: Digili kɛ k'a to a ka mɔgɔw yira.
document_tts_intro: I ni cɛ, aw bisimila sɛbɛn nyɛ kan. Yan, i bɛ se ka sɛbɛn wala fura sɛbɛn foto ta. Ne bɛna a kalan k'a ɲɛfɔ i ye ni ɲagami tɛ.
document_desc_take_photo: Foto ta yɔrɔ. I ka sɛbɛn foto ta.
document_desc_gallery: I ka telefɔni foto dɔ ta.
document_loading_label: Makɔnɔ, ne bɛ ka sɛbɛn kalan.
document_summary_offline: Ɛntɛrinɛti tɛ. Ɲɛfɔli tɛ se ka kɛ.
document_scanner_tts_intro: I bɛ foto-minɛnyɔrɔ la. I ka sɛbɛn bila ka jɛgɛn kabakuru kɔnɔ min bɛ ekran kan, o kɔ i ka digi buto belebele mixibulen kan ka foto ta.
document_scanner_desc_back: Kɔsegin. Dabila ka segin ɲɛfɛla kan.
document_scanner_desc_capture: Foto ta. Sɛbɛn min bɛ kabakuru kɔnɔ, o foto ta.
document_scanner_permission_text: Porogaramu in mago bɛ foto-minɛnyɔrɔ la walisa ka i ka sɛbɛnw foto ta.
document_scanner_desc_allow: Foto-minɛnyɔrɔ yamaruya walisa i ka se ka foto ta.
health_desc_cancel_med: Dabila. Tugu k'a sɔrɔ i ma fura dɔ fara a kan.
health_desc_cancel_appt: Dabila. Tugu k'a sɔrɔ i ma bɛn-ɲɔgɔn dɔ fara a kan.
health_notif_med: I ka fura ta waati sera.
health_notif_appt_soon: Ɲɔgɔnye waati bɛ lɛrɛ kelen kɔnɔ.
health_notif_appt_actual: I ka ɲɔgɔnye waati sera sisan.
health_tts_intro: I ni cɛ, aw bisimila kɛnɛya nyɛ kan. Yan, i bɛ se k'i ka dɔgɔtɔrɔ ɲɔgɔnyew ni furaw mara. O cogo la, ne bɛ se k'a hakili jigi i la waati bɛnnen na.
notif_med_tts: I ni cɛ, {{name}} ta waati sera.
help_tts_intro: I ni cɛ, aw bisimila dɛmɛ nyɛ kan. Yan, i bɛ se ka ɲininkali kɛ kuma na ni i bɛ ekran digi, wala ka dɔgɔtɔrɔ teliya wele duguma.
help_disclaimer: ⚠️ Ɲininkali jaabi in kɛra masini ye. I kɛnɛya kama, dɔgɔtɔrɔ ɲini.
map_tts_intro: I ni cɛ, aw bisimila karti nyɛ kan. Yan, i bɛ se ka dɛmɛ yɔrɔw ɲini i gɛrɛfɛ, ani ne bɛ se k'i ɲɛminɛ ka taa yen ni GPS ye.
contacts_desc_voice: Kontaki fara a kan ni kuma ye. Digili kɛ ka daminɛ.
contacts_voice_listening: N bɛ i lamɛn. Fɔ tɔgɔ, ka tila ka telefɔni nimɔrɔ fɔ.
contacts_voice_processing: N bɛ i ka kuma faamu…
contacts_voice_no_permission: Mikoro sɔnni tɛ yen. I ka telefɔni paramɛtiri lajɛ.
contacts_voice_result_tts: N y'a faamu: {{name}}, nimɔrɔ {{phone}}. A lajɛ ka mara.
contacts_voice_not_understood: N ma se k'a faamu ka ɲɛ. A ta kokura walla a sɛbɛn i tigi bolo la.
contacts_desc_cancel_add: Dabila. Tugu k'a sɔrɔ i ma jamaba dɔ fara a kan.
contacts_desc_cancel_import: Dabila. Lisi tugu k'a sɔrɔ i ma jamaba dɔ sugandi.
contacts_desc_cancel_voice: Dabila. Jamaba fara-kan kumakan fɔli dabila.
